>## Summary
>
>- Vendors the `manifests-gen` fix from openshift/cluster-capi-operator#618 and regenerates manifests.
>- The `capa-controller-manager` Deployment container changes from `imagePullPolicy: Always` to `IfNotPresent`.
>- Fixes disconnected cluster upgrades using pinned image sets, where pods crash with `ImagePullBackOff` because the kubelet tries to pull images that are already present on the node.
>
>Depends on: https://github.com/openshift/cluster-capi-operator/pull/618 (merged)
>
>## Test plan
>
>- [ ] Run upgrade in a techpreview disconnected cluster using only pinned image sets and verify `capa-controller-manager` pods no longer crash with `ImagePullBackOff`
>- [ ] Verify `capa-controller-manager` Deployment has `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent`

The [e2e-aws-ovn](https://prow.ci.openshift.org/view/gs/prow-artifact-archive/pr-logs/pull/openshift_cluster-capi-operator/585/pull-ci-openshift-cluster-capi-operator-main-e2e-aws-ovn/2074565551841087488) specific job failure is a known flake, not related to this PR

[OCPBUGS-97822](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/OCPBUGS-97822) HAProxy router http2 test fails with "Expected HTTP/1.1 to equal HTTP/2.0" on HyperShift AWS conformance (5.0)
- Status: POST (fix in progress)
- Component: Networking / router
- Root cause: This is a test issue, not a product bug, there's a DNS race condition where the test's readiness check can receive a response from the default router (HTTP/1.1) instead of the dedicated HTTP/2 router shard before DNS propagation completes


Hence overriding

/override ci/prow/e2e-aws-ovn
